questions.question: Whom does Micah 2 pronounce woe on?
options: Those who plot evil and seize fields and houses
Those who mourn in sackcloth and ashes
Those who keep the holy Sabbath and all the feasts
Those who flee before the coming army
questions.answer: Those who plot evil and seize fields and houses
